## Week 4 Warm-up Test

::: {.callout-note}
This is a **graded warm-up test**.

You have **10 minutes** from the moment you start. You may run your code while working. There is no correctness feedback. Submit your solution before the timer reaches zero; if the page remains open, it will be submitted automatically when time expires.

**Test window rule:** During the test, you must remain on this test page. Do not switch to another browser tab, window, or application. The **first detected switch** results in a warning. The **second detected switch** automatically submits your current solution and ends the test.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
### Important – in-class assessment

This test may only be completed by students who are **physically present in the scheduled practical session**.

Completing the test without being present in the classroom is not permitted and will result in **0 points for the test**.
:::

Enter your **Neptun code** and the **classroom access code** displayed by your instructor.

```{=html}
<div id="warmup-app">

  <div id="start-panel">

        <input
          id="neptun"
          type="text"
          maxlength="6"
          autocomplete="off"
          spellcheck="false">
      </div>

      <div class="warmup-field">
        <label for="access-code">
          <strong>Classroom access code</strong>
        </label>

        <input
          id="access-code"
          type="text"
          maxlength="6"
          autocomplete="off"
          spellcheck="false">
      </div>

    </div>

    <p class="start-note">
      The classroom access code is displayed by your instructor at the beginning of the test.
    </p>

    <div class="rules-ack">
      <label>
        <input id="accept-rules" type="checkbox">
        I confirm that I am present in the classroom and that I have read and understood the test rules, including the window-switch rule.
      </label>
    </div>

    <div class="warmup-row">
      <button id="start-warmup" type="button">
        Start test
      </button>
    </div>

    <p id="warmup-message"></p>

  </div>

  <div id="warmup-panel">

    <div id="warmup-meta">

      <span>
        <strong>Session group:</strong>

      </span>

      <span>
        <strong>Time remaining:</strong>
        <span id="timer">10:00</span>
      </span>

    </div>

      </button>

      <button id="submit-code" type="button">

      </button>

      <span id="runtime-status"></span>

    <p id="submission-message"></p>

  </div>

  <div
    id="warmup-warning-overlay"
    role="dialog"
    aria-modal="true"
    aria-labelledby="warmup-warning-title">

      <h3 id="warmup-warning-title">
        Warning – window switch detected
      </h3>

      <p>

      </p>

      <p>
        <strong>
          If you leave the test window again, your current solution will be submitted automatically and the test will end.
        </strong>

      <button id="continue-test" type="button">

      </button>

    </div>

  </div>

</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.27.7/full/pyodide.js"></script>

<script>
(() => {

  const API_BASE =
    "https://itarch-backend-fpdsf6brfpanf5d8.northeurope-01.azurewebsites.net/api";

  const TEST_ID = "week04";

  const NEPTUN_KEY =
    "pycourse_neptun";

  const ACCESS_CODE_KEY =
    `pycourse_access_code_${TEST_ID}`;

  const ACTIVE_TEST_KEY =
    `pycourse_active_test_${TEST_ID}`;

  function resultTokenKey(neptun) {
    return `pycourse_result_token_${TEST_ID}_${neptun}`;
  }

  function draftKey(neptun) {
    return `pycourse_draft_${TEST_ID}_${neptun}`;
  }


  let assignment = null;
  let pyodide = null;
  let runCount = 0;
  let timerHandle = null;
  let submitting = false;
  let submitted = false;
  let focusLossCount = 0;
  let hiddenSince = null;
  let visibilityCheckHandle = null;

  const FOCUS_LOSS_THRESHOLD_MS = 1500;


  const $ = (id) =>
    document.getElementById(id);


  const app =
    $("warmup-app");

  const neptunInput =
    $("neptun");

  const accessCodeInput =
    $("access-code");

  const startButton =
    $("start-warmup");

  const startMessage =
    $("warmup-message");

  const panel =
    $("warmup-panel");

  const editor =
    $("code-editor");

  const output =
    $("program-output");

  const runButton =
    $("run-code");

  const submitButton =
    $("submit-code");

  const runtimeStatus =
    $("runtime-status");

  const submissionMessage =
    $("submission-message");

  const acceptRules =
    $("accept-rules");

  const warningOverlay =
    $("warmup-warning-overlay");

  const continueTestButton =
    $("continue-test");


  /*
   * Restore saved Neptun.
   */

  const savedNeptun =
    localStorage.getItem(NEPTUN_KEY);

  if (savedNeptun) {
    neptunInput.value = savedNeptun;
  }


  /*
   * Restore classroom access code
   * for this browser session.
   */

  const savedAccessCode =
    sessionStorage.getItem(ACCESS_CODE_KEY);

  if (savedAccessCode) {
    accessCodeInput.value = savedAccessCode;
  }


  /*
   * Result tokens are stored per student.
   * Do not display a previous student's result
   * automatically on a shared classroom PC.
   */

  function getSavedResultToken(neptun) {
    if (!validNeptun(neptun)) {
      return null;
    }

    return localStorage.getItem(
      resultTokenKey(neptun)
    );
  }


  function showAlreadySubmitted(neptun, token) {
    const resultUrl =
      buildResultUrl(token);

    submitted = true;
    clearInterval(timerHandle);

    app.classList.add(
      "submitted-state"
    );

    panel.style.display =
      "block";

    startMessage.textContent = "";

    submissionMessage.className =
      "submitted-box";

    submissionMessage.innerHTML = `
      <p>
        <strong>Test already submitted</strong>
      </p>

      <p class="result-note">
        The Week 4 test for ${neptun} has already been submitted.
        It cannot be modified or submitted again.
      </p>

      <div class="result-actions">
        <a
          class="result-link"
          href="${resultUrl}">
          View result
        </a>
      </div>
    `;
  }


  function validNeptun(value) {
    return /^[A-Z0-9]{6}$/.test(value);
  }


  function validAccessCode(value) {
    return /^[A-Z0-9]{6}$/.test(value);
  }


  async function postJson(url, body) {

    const response =
      await fetch(url, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(body)
      });

    let data = {};

    try {
      data = await response.json();
    } catch (_) {}

    if (
      !response.ok ||
      data.success === false
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        data.error ||
        `Request failed (${response.status}).`
      );
    }

    return data;
  }


  function formatRemaining(ms) {

    const total =
      Math.max(
        0,
        Math.ceil(ms / 1000)
      );

    const min =
      Math.floor(total / 60);

    const sec =
      total % 60;

    return `${min}:${String(sec).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  }


  function startTimer() {

    clearInterval(timerHandle);

    const tick = async () => {

      if (!assignment) {
        return;
      }

      const remaining =
        new Date(
          assignment.deadline
        ).getTime() -
        Date.now();

      $("timer").textContent =
        formatRemaining(remaining);

      $("timer")
        .classList
        .toggle(
          "timer-warning",
          remaining <= 60000
        );

      if (remaining <= 0) {

        clearInterval(timerHandle);

        await submitSolution(
          "timeout"
        );
      }
    };

    tick();

    timerHandle =
      setInterval(
        tick,
        1000
      );
  }


  function showAssignment(data) {

    assignment = data;

    $("group-value").textContent =
      data.session_group ||
      data.group ||
      "";

    const task =
      data.tasks?.[0];

    if (!task) {
      throw new Error(
        "No task was assigned."
      );
    }


    let taskHtml =
      `<h3>${task.title || "Task"}</h3>` +
      `<p>${task.text || ""}</p>`;


    if (task.image) {

      taskHtml += `
        <p>
          <a
            href="${task.image}"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener">

            <img
              src="${task.image}"
              alt="Task image"
              style="max-width:220px;height:auto;">
          </a>
        </p>
      `;
    }


    if (data.rules_text) {

      taskHtml += `
        <p>
          <strong>Rules:</strong>
          ${data.rules_text}
        </p>
      `;
    }


    if (
      task.expected_output?.enabled &&
      task.expected_output?.text
    ) {

      taskHtml += `
        <p>
          <strong>Expected output:</strong>
          ${task.expected_output.text}
        </p>
      `;
    }


    $("warmup-task").innerHTML =
      taskHtml;


    const neptun =
      neptunInput
        .value
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();

    const savedDraft =
      sessionStorage.getItem(
        draftKey(neptun)
      );

    if (savedDraft !== null) {
      editor.value = savedDraft;
    }


    startButton.disabled = true;
    neptunInput.disabled = true;
    accessCodeInput.disabled = true;
    acceptRules.disabled = true;

    panel.style.display =
      "block";


    sessionStorage.setItem(
      ACTIVE_TEST_KEY,
      "1"
    );


    startTimer();
  }


  async function startOrResumeTest(
    automatic = false
  ) {

    const neptun =
      neptunInput
        .value
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();

    const accessCode =
      accessCodeInput
        .value
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();


    neptunInput.value =
      neptun;

    accessCodeInput.value =
      accessCode;


    if (!validNeptun(neptun)) {

      if (!automatic) {
        startMessage.textContent =
          "Please enter a valid 6-character Neptun code.";
      }

      return false;
    }


    if (!validAccessCode(accessCode)) {

      if (!automatic) {
        startMessage.textContent =
          "Please enter the 6-character classroom access code.";
      }

      return false;
    }


    if (
      !automatic &&
      !acceptRules.checked
    ) {

      startMessage.textContent =
        "Please confirm that you are present in the classroom and that you have read and understood the test rules.";

      return false;
    }


    const existingResultToken =
      getSavedResultToken(neptun);

    if (existingResultToken) {
      showAlreadySubmitted(
        neptun,
        existingResultToken
      );

      return false;
    }


    startButton.disabled = true;

    startMessage.textContent =
      automatic
        ? "Restoring your test..."
        : "Starting...";


    try {

      const data =
        await postJson(
          `${API_BASE}/startTest`,
          {
            test_id: TEST_ID,
            neptun: neptun,
            access_code: accessCode
          }
        );


      localStorage.setItem(
        NEPTUN_KEY,
        neptun
      );


      sessionStorage.setItem(
        ACCESS_CODE_KEY,
        accessCode
      );


      sessionStorage.setItem(
        ACTIVE_TEST_KEY,
        "1"
      );


      startMessage.textContent =
        data.resumed
          ? "Existing test restored."
          : "";


      showAssignment(data);

      return true;


    } catch (err) {

      startMessage.textContent =
        automatic
          ? (
              "Your active test could not be restored automatically. " +
              err.message
            )
          : err.message;


      startButton.disabled =
        false;

      return false;
    }
  }


  startButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    async () => {

      await startOrResumeTest(false);

    }
  );


  /*
   * Automatic recovery after refresh.
   */

  async function tryAutomaticResume() {

    const active =
      sessionStorage.getItem(
        ACTIVE_TEST_KEY
      );


    const storedNeptun =
      localStorage.getItem(
        NEPTUN_KEY
      );


    const storedAccessCode =
      sessionStorage.getItem(
        ACCESS_CODE_KEY
      );


    if (storedNeptun) {
      const storedResultToken =
        getSavedResultToken(storedNeptun);

      if (storedResultToken) {
        sessionStorage.removeItem(
          ACTIVE_TEST_KEY
        );

        sessionStorage.removeItem(
          ACCESS_CODE_KEY
        );

        showAlreadySubmitted(
          storedNeptun,
          storedResultToken
        );

        return;
      }
    }


    if (
      active !== "1" ||
      !storedNeptun ||
      !storedAccessCode
    ) {
      return;
    }


    neptunInput.value =
      storedNeptun;

    accessCodeInput.value =
      storedAccessCode;


    await startOrResumeTest(true);
  }


  /*
   * Window-switch detection.
   */

  function showFirstFocusWarning() {

    editor.disabled = true;
    runButton.disabled = true;
    submitButton.disabled = true;

    warningOverlay.style.display =
      "flex";
  }


  continueTestButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    () => {

      warningOverlay.style.display =
        "none";


      if (
        !submitted &&
        !submitting
      ) {

        editor.disabled = false;
        runButton.disabled = false;
        submitButton.disabled = false;

        editor.focus();
      }
    }
  );


  async function registerFocusLoss() {

    if (
      !assignment ||
      submitted ||
      submitting
    ) {
      return;
    }


    focusLossCount += 1;


    if (focusLossCount === 1) {

      showFirstFocusWarning();

      return;
    }


    warningOverlay.style.display =
      "none";


    await submitSolution(
      "window_switch"
    );
  }


  document.addEventListener(
    "visibilitychange",
    () => {

      if (
        !assignment ||
        submitted ||
        submitting
      ) {
        return;
      }


      if (document.hidden) {

        hiddenSince =
          Date.now();


        clearTimeout(
          visibilityCheckHandle
        );


        visibilityCheckHandle =
          setTimeout(
            () => {

              if (
                document.hidden &&
                hiddenSince !== null &&
                Date.now() - hiddenSince >=
                  FOCUS_LOSS_THRESHOLD_MS
              ) {

                hiddenSince = null;

                registerFocusLoss();
              }

            },
            FOCUS_LOSS_THRESHOLD_MS
          );

      } else {

        clearTimeout(
          visibilityCheckHandle
        );

        visibilityCheckHandle =
          null;

        hiddenSince =
          null;
      }
    }
  );


  /*
   * Pyodide.
   */

  async function ensurePyodide() {

    if (pyodide) {
      return pyodide;
    }


    runtimeStatus.textContent =
      "Loading Python...";


    pyodide =
      await loadPyodide();


    runtimeStatus.textContent =
      "Python ready.";


    return pyodide;
  }


  /*
   * Run code.
   */

  runButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    async () => {

      if (
        !assignment ||
        submitted
      ) {
        return;
      }


      if (
        Date.now() >=
        new Date(
          assignment.deadline
        ).getTime()
      ) {

        await submitSolution(
          "timeout"
        );

        return;
      }


      runButton.disabled = true;

      output.textContent = "";


      try {

        const py =
          await ensurePyodide();


        py.setStdout({
          batched: (s) => {
            output.textContent +=
              s + "\n";
          }
        });


        py.setStderr({
          batched: (s) => {
            output.textContent +=
              s + "\n";
          }
        });


        py.setStdin({

          stdin: () => {

            const value =
              window.prompt(
                "Python input:"
              );


            if (value === null) {

              throw new Error(
                "Input cancelled."
              );
            }


            output.textContent +=
              value + "\n";

            return value;
          }
        });


        runCount += 1;


        /*
         * Python input() normally writes its prompt to stdout.
         * The browser dialog already provides the input UI, so
         * suppress the Python prompt to avoid duplicate text
         * such as "price: 40" in Program output.
         */
        const codeForRun =
          editor.value.replace(
            /input\s*\(([^)]*)\)/g,
            "input()"
          );

        await py.runPythonAsync(
          codeForRun
        );


      } catch (err) {

        output.textContent +=
          String(err);


      } finally {

        if (!submitted) {
          runButton.disabled =
            false;
        }
      }
    }
  );


  function buildResultUrl(token) {

    const base =
      new URL(
        "../results/",
        window.location.href
      );


    base.searchParams.set(
      "token",
      token
    );


    return base.toString();
  }


  function showSubmissionReceipt(
    data,
    type
  ) {

    const resultUrl =
      buildResultUrl(
        data.result_token
      );


    const reason =

      type === "timeout"

        ? `
          <p class="result-note">
            <strong>Time is up.</strong>
            Your current solution was submitted automatically.
          </p>
        `

        : type === "window_switch"

        ? `
          <p class="result-note">
            <strong>Test ended.</strong>
            A second window switch was detected and your current solution was submitted automatically.
          </p>
        `

        : "";


    submissionMessage.className =
      "submitted-box";


    submissionMessage.innerHTML = `

      <p>
        <strong>✓ Submission received</strong>
      </p>

      ${reason}

      <p class="result-note">
        ${
          data.message ||
          "Your submission has been saved and locked."
        }
      </p>

      <p class="result-note">
        ${
          data.preliminary_result_message ||
          "Preliminary results are usually available within approximately 15 minutes."
        }
      </p>

      <p class="result-note">
        ${
          data.final_result_message ||
          "Final results will normally be available within one week after instructor review."
        }
      </p>

      <p class="result-note">
        Use the button below to check your result later.
      </p>

      <div class="result-actions">

        <a
          class="result-link"
          href="${resultUrl}">
          View result
        </a>

      </div>
    `;
  }


  async function submitSolution(type) {

    if (
      !assignment ||
      submitted ||
      submitting
    ) {
      return;
    }


    submitting = true;

    runButton.disabled = true;
    submitButton.disabled = true;
    editor.disabled = true;


    submissionMessage.textContent =

      type === "timeout"
        ? "Time is up. Submitting..."

        : type === "window_switch"
        ? "Second window switch detected. Submitting your current solution..."

        : "Submitting...";


    try {

      const data =
        await postJson(
          `${API_BASE}/submitTest`,
          {

            test_id: TEST_ID,

            neptun:
              neptunInput
                .value
                .trim()
                .toUpperCase(),

            assignment_id:
              assignment.assignment_id,

            solutions: [
              {
                task_id:
                  assignment.tasks[0].id,

                code:
                  editor.value,

                run_count:
                  runCount
              }
            ],

            submission_type:
              type
          }
        );


      submitted = true;


      const neptun =
        neptunInput
          .value
          .trim()
          .toUpperCase();


      if (data.result_token) {

        localStorage.setItem(
          resultTokenKey(neptun),
          data.result_token
        );
      }


      sessionStorage.removeItem(
        draftKey(neptun)
      );


      sessionStorage.removeItem(
        ACTIVE_TEST_KEY
      );


      sessionStorage.removeItem(
        ACCESS_CODE_KEY
      );


      clearInterval(timerHandle);


      $("warmup-task").style.display =
        "none";


      output.style.display =
        "none";


      runtimeStatus.textContent =
        "";


      showSubmissionReceipt(
        data,
        type
      );


    } catch (err) {

      editor.disabled = false;


      if (
        Date.now() <
        new Date(
          assignment.deadline
        ).getTime()
      ) {

        runButton.disabled = false;
        submitButton.disabled = false;

      } else {

        submitButton.disabled = false;
      }


      submissionMessage.className =
        "";


      submissionMessage.textContent =
        `Submission failed: ${err.message} Please try Submit again.`;


    } finally {

      submitting = false;
    }
  }


  /*
   * Use TAB inside the editor for Python indentation.
   * One TAB inserts four spaces.
   */

  editor.addEventListener(
    "keydown",
    (event) => {

      if (
        event.key !== "Tab" ||
        editor.disabled
      ) {
        return;
      }

      event.preventDefault();

      const start =
        editor.selectionStart;

      const end =
        editor.selectionEnd;

      const indent =
        "    ";

      editor.value =
        editor.value.substring(0, start) +
        indent +
        editor.value.substring(end);

      editor.selectionStart =
        editor.selectionEnd =
          start + indent.length;

      /*
       * Trigger the existing draft autosave.
       */
      editor.dispatchEvent(
        new Event(
          "input",
          { bubbles: true }
        )
      );
    }
  );


  editor.addEventListener(
    "input",
    () => {

      const neptun =
        neptunInput
          .value
          .trim()
          .toUpperCase();

      if (
        assignment &&
        !submitted &&
        validNeptun(neptun)
      ) {
        sessionStorage.setItem(
          draftKey(neptun),
          editor.value
        );
      }
    }
  );


  submitButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    () => submitSolution("manual")
  );


  /*
   * Force both codes to uppercase
   * alphanumeric values.
   */

  neptunInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    () => {

      neptunInput.value =
        neptunInput
          .value
          .toUpperCase()
          .replace(
            /[^A-Z0-9]/g,
            ""
          )
          .slice(0, 6);

      submissionMessage.className =
        "";

      submissionMessage.textContent =
        "";
    }
  );


  accessCodeInput.addEventListener(
    "input",
    () => {

      accessCodeInput.value =
        accessCodeInput
          .value
          .toUpperCase()
          .replace(
            /[^A-Z0-9]/g,
            ""
          )
          .slice(0, 6);
    }
  );


  /*
   * If the page was refreshed during an
   * active test, restore the original
   * assignment and original deadline.
   */

  tryAutomaticResume();

})();
</script>
```
